sentences.text: Maria loved Saturdays.
Every Saturday, she went to the market.
The market was full of colors and sounds.
Maria liked to buy fresh fruits and vegetables.
She also liked to talk to the sellers.
They were always friendly and happy to see her.
One Saturday, Maria saw a new seller.
He had a small stand with beautiful flowers.
Maria loved flowers.
She walked to the stand and smiled at the seller.
"Hello," she said.
"Your flowers are very pretty."
The seller smiled back.
"Thank you," he said.
"I grow them myself."
Maria looked at the flowers.
There were roses, tulips, and daisies.
She picked a bunch of daisies.
"I will take these," she said.
The seller wrapped the flowers in paper.
"Here you go," he said.
"Have a nice day."
Maria paid for the flowers and walked away.
She felt happy.
The flowers were bright and cheerful.
She thought about where to put them in her home.
As she walked, Maria saw her friend, Ana.
Ana was buying apples.
"Hi, Ana!" Maria called.
Ana turned and smiled.
"Hi, Maria!" she said.
"Those flowers are beautiful."
"Thank you," Maria said.
"I just bought them from a new seller."
Ana looked at the flowers.
"They are very nice," she said.
"I think I will buy some too."
Maria and Ana walked to the flower stand together.
The seller smiled when he saw them.
"Hello again," he said to Maria.
"And hello to your friend."
"Hi," Ana said.
"I would like some flowers too."
The seller helped Ana pick some flowers.
She chose a bunch of tulips.
"These are perfect," she said.
Maria and Ana left the market together.
They talked and laughed.
They both felt happy with their flowers.
It was a good day at the market.
When Maria got home, she put the daisies in a vase.
They looked beautiful on her table.
She smiled and thought about the nice day she had.
She was glad she went to the market and met the new seller.
She looked forward to next Saturday.
